summary: Inverse Laplace transform. The result holds for t ≥ 0.

methods.name: Partial fractions and table
methods.reason: The transform is a rational function of \(s\) with delay factors.

steps.title: Identify the delay factors
steps.text: A factor \(e^{-as}\) delays the function by \(a\) and switches it on at \(t = a\) (second shifting theorem). Invert what multiplies it first.

steps.title: Invert each piece
steps.text: Complete the square in the denominator and match the sine and cosine entries.

steps.title: Apply the delay
steps.text: Replace \(t\) by \(t - 2\) and multiply by the unit step.

steps.title: Check
steps.text: Checked by transforming the answer forward again.

methods.verify_note: Checked by transforming the answer forward again.
